intro.heading: One Plan For All Your Needs.
intro.text:
Forge was designed with the purpose of being an accessible strength space for all, no matter your level of knowledge exercising on a gym.

If you are experienced, just starting, or want a way of building community and connections while you build a stronger body, we have an option for you.
intro.heading_mobile:
One Plan For
All Your Needs.

perks.heading: The Perks.
perks.card_1_text: FORGE space is reserved for a small or individual groups only. No waiting for equipment during your workout.
perks.card_2_text: We have coaches and trainers who know your name and help you achieve your goals.
perks.card_3_text: Our group classes are designed to support each other and build connections while building strength.

memberships.heading: forge membership exclusives.
memberships.group_text: Small-group strength training with personalized coaching, structured workouts, and individual attention to proper technique.
memberships.training_text: One-on-one strength training tailored to each client's goals, experience, and needs.

training_popup.heading: personal training (1 : 1).
training_popup.text:
One-on-one strength training tailored to each client's goals, experience, and needs. Sessions include individualized coaching, exercise technique, and personalized programming.

\*Duo and trio training may also be available upon request. Clients can contact us to discuss pricing and availability.

rental.heading: private gym rental.
rental.text:
Self-guided workouts.

Clients can rent the studio to use the equipment and complete their own workouts independently, without coaching.

You are welcome to bring your own workout routine or follow a custom workout program from us!

rental_popup.heading: private gym rental.
rental_popup.text:
Clients can rent the studio to use the equipment and complete their own workouts independently, without coaching. You are welcome to bring your own workout routine or follow a custom workout program from us!

\*Rental package hours can be used across multiple visits within the validity period. Unused hours expire and do not roll over.

trainers.heading: studio rental for personal trainers.
trainers.text: If you are a personal trainer, you can rent our studio space to train your own clients.

trainers_popup.heading: studio rental for personal trainers.

\*Discounted rates are available only when purchasing a package. Hours can be used across multiple visits within the validity period. Unused hours expire and do not roll over.

custom
workout
programs.
programs.text:
Our studio provides custom workout programs so you can have a better direction when designing your journey to a healthier life.

We can also provide you with exclusive consultation to guide you in the right direction.

programs_popup.heading: Custom workout programs.
programs_popup.text:
Our studio provides custom workout programs and exclusive consultation so you can have a better direction when designing your journey to a healthier life. Choose between our two options:

- Custom written workout program: $75 — A personalized program designed around the client's goals, training experience, and available equipment, to follow independently.
- Custom program + consultation: $150 — Includes a personalized workout program and one 60-minute in-person consultation at Forge to demonstrate the exercises, explain equipment setup, and review technique.

\*Gym rental is booked separately and is not included in either program.

hotel.heading: Hotel Guest Exclusive Spots & Discounts.
hotel.text: Guest from the Holiday Inn and local nearby hotels get a 10% off discount at FORGE Studios. We believe your short stay does not to be full of dealing with crowded and under equipped gyms, so we have a space ready for you.
